name: Lambert-Eaton Myasthenic Syndrome
definition: Autoimmune presynaptic neuromuscular-junction disorder causing proximal weakness, autonomic symptoms and reduced reflexes, sometimes associated with small-cell lung cancer.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostic testing and voltage-gated calcium-channel antibodies support diagnosis; cancer screening is important.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Immunotherapy and symptomatic treatment are specialist-directed.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bala/Vata-neuromuscular phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Autoimmune presynaptic neuromuscular-junction disorder causing proximal weakness, autonomic symptoms and reduced reflexes, sometimes associated with small-cell lung cancer.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
